verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents a first-party path for connecting coding tools through Nexus CLI, with Fireworks models selectable directly or via Nexus Auto [docs-59], and markets itself as a drop-in replacement for AI coding [docs-11]. Its OpenAI-compatible endpoint and tool-calling specs let agents be built against it [docs-56, docs-36, docs-42]. However, the evidence shows no named integration guides for specific coding agents or agent frameworks, only a single summary line on Nexus CLI. missing for 10: named per-tool guides for coding agents (e.g. specific IDE/CLI agents), first-party guides for agent frameworks, depth of the Nexus CLI documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
